events.name: Mike Maimone
events.info: Celebrate with Mike Maimone, on tour for the release of his 15th album and 1st book, both called Guess What? I Love You. This show features Mike performing songs from his new album on solo piano. Guiding the audience on an emotional journey, he will also read short selections from his book, which received a Kirkus recommendation, endorsements from Don Lemon, Anthony Scaramucci and other bestselling authors, and Los Angeles Magazine called it "a moving account of love, loss and the radical act of staying open to possibility." The companion pieces are a tribute to Maimone's late husband Howard Bragman, who championed the LGBTQ+ community by helping celebrities navigate their coming out journeys, and was a beloved luminary sharing his insights on everything from RuPaul's Drag Race to Good Morning America. Maimone's piano-based music is often compared to Randy Newman, Leon Russell, Tom Waits, and Dr. John. With over 200 published songs, he has been heard on Spotify and Apple Music editorial playlists, movie and TV soundtracks, on the radio, and he has performed at major festivals and legendary venues across the country and internationally, toured with bands including Blues Traveler, Plain White T's and OK Go, and shared the stage with Stevie Wonder.

events.name: All Elite Wrestling Presents DYNAMITE
events.info: All Elite Wrestling in Action A night at an All Elite Wrestling show is packed with action. Boasting an impressive roster of diverse male and female wrestlers, All Elite Wrestling features a wide variety of wrestling styles and twist-filled plots. A typical AEW night involves being right there for the broadcast of its flagship TBS show, AEW Dynamite, or the newest TNT show, AEW Collision. Be there live to see all the athleticism, big personalities, exciting storylines, and hard-hitting wrestling action that has become synonymous with AEW and expect a night of epic rivalries and unforgettable matches with all the stars you love to watch.

events.name: CeCe Winans-COME WORSHIP! Tour
events.info: The COME WORSHIP! Tour is an invitation from CeCe Winans to bring together audiences of every generation, ethnicity, and denomination while worshipping Jesus as a unified congregation. Winans is excited to bring along some of the biggest worship leaders for an evening designed to be unlike anything audiences have experienced before. Joined by special guest Charity Gayle, whose anthems including "Thank You Jesus for the Blood" and "I Speak Jesus" have become modern worship staples, the tour creates a sacred space marked by faith, expectancy, and unity. Rounding out the night will be Red Worship and Terrian, two of the newest and most powerful voices in worship music.

events.name: The Blooming Trio
events.info: The Blooming Trio is a soulful collaboration of singer-songwriters Bethany Joy, Josee McGee, and Skye Burkett three artists from the heart of the Rust Belt whose powerful voices intertwine in three part harmonies.Keys, acoustic and electric guitar accompany each other creating an intimate, genre-bending sound that feels both timeless and fresh. Drawing from influences that span indie rock, jazz, folk, and soul, their music blooms with raw emotion, lyrical depth, and vibrant chemistry.

Brand New Hat
events.info: Brand New Hat is a popular Northern Ohio quartet consisting of Dan McMillan (lead guitar, vocals), Dave Kennard (banjo, harmonica, vocals) John Hansen (bass, harmonica, vocals) and Roland Kausen (mandolin, vocals). The band has been entertaining folks for over twenty years with their upbeat sound. Their music is a blend, drawing from the roots of bluegrass, traditional, folk and contemporary stylings. Brand New Hat brings a fresh style, hot playing, tight vocals, and a unique interpretation to familiar songs; as well as featuring numerous original compositions.
